acceptance: one-sided anytime paired sign p-bound <= 0.01, decode improvement; no prefill regression
futility: stop after two completed pairs if neither decode pair improves
selection: choose depth on separate short diagnostics before any full comparison; freeze flags and loaded library hashes per arm
baseline: current gated fn/ship frozen build available at first full run
reserve_gate: 100K+128 development gate with single-pass B1 required, whole-card VRAM <=23552MiB; all short model/reload gates retain2560MiB. Matched full arms use the same passing reserve.
provider: accepted host cache, GGML_MOE_CACHE_DEVICE=0 and FUSED=0 in both arms
